lines.zh: 我慢慢摆着丝一样的鳍。
lines.en: I wave my threadlike fins slowly.
I rise close along the weed.
I head for the upper layer.
I move forward in gentle swings.

lines.zh: 我从两株水草之间穿过。
lines.en: I pass between two strands of weed.
I swim around that wooden post.
I ease around a bend.
I make for the floating leaves.
I tilt my body once.
I sink a few inches deeper.
I cruise along the mud.
I make for the shallows.
I swim along the edge of the weed.
I rise a little more.
I pivot slowly on the spot.
I head into the murk.
I swing back a short stretch.
I go around a sunken branch.
I hang there with my long fins trailing.
I hold still and let my fins drift.
I bring my mouth to the surface.
There is a skin of foam on the surface.
My gills move slowly.

lines.zh: 我在这块水面待了很久。
lines.en: I have stayed at this patch a long while.
The weed touches my flank.
I release another string of bubbles.
I wait for something to fall.
I bend my body once.
I sink a finger's width.
I hang there, making no move.
The wind wrinkles the surface.
I angle toward the light.
I face you from the water.
Your reflection is clear.
I float to the shallow edge.
I look over both your hands.
When you crouch, I come closer.
I bring my mouth to the surface.
You hold still, so I stay.
I shrink behind the weed.
I am in your shadow.
I sink slowly away.
I thrash to get away.
That landed on my flank.
I lie on the mud without moving.
A notch is missing from one fin.
Mud boils up from the bottom.
I slowly settle my body.
I hide under the weed.
My tail still opens.

lines.zh: 小气泡从我嘴里冒出来。
lines.en: Small bubbles rise from my mouth.
I keep that in my fins.
There is something on the surface.
I float up a little at a time.
I open my mouth and sip.
That is a very small mouthful.
I eat at a slow pace.
That is not enough for me.
I ease toward your hand.
I eat with my eyes fixed on you.
When the surface moves, I back off.
I circle that patch.
The knock tips my flank.
I steady with my fins.
The water is churned cloudy.
I shrink into the weed.
I slide away past your leg.
That leaves my fins all awry.
I swing slowly back into place.
I cannot see ahead.
I sink and go still.
Stop knocking my fins.
We float in a row.
It circles the weed.
I lean my body toward it.
We settle together into the mud.
It moves and the water shakes.
Our shadows lie as one.
I follow it a stretch.
It goes and the water stills.
I drift slowly apart.
That amounts to nothing.
I draw it in with one mouthful.
I hold it and grind slowly.
This piece is too hard to bite.
It slipped past my lips.
I taste it; very faint.
I gulp the whole piece down.
I rise to look for more.
I spit it out; not good.
I search along the surface.
Enough; I sink to the bottom.
Ripples spread on the surface.
I angle toward where it came from.
I fix on that movement.
I hug my body to the mud.
I ease in slowly.
It has not yet noticed.
I push my upper lip above the surface.
I wait for it to move again.
The weed covers me.
This bite must not miss.
I follow the ripples.
When it moves, I change position.
I hold beneath it.
I wait for it near the bank.
It holds and so do I.
I draw my long fins in.
The surface shifts a lot.
A little closer will do.
I rise up slowly.
The water hides my sound.
I bite it and drag it down.
I shake my head once.
I ram its flank.
That bite took hold.
One twist and it tore free.
I bite a second time.
I drag it in among the weed.
The water churns.
It draws off and I sink to the bottom.

lines.zh: 那股味道还挂在我嘴里。
lines.en: That taste still hangs in my mouth.
I rise up out of the weed.
The water here is slow.
I test the current first.
There is a layer of mud below.
I swim one circle by the bank.
Quite a few insects have landed on the surface.
I shelter behind the post.
I straighten my body slowly.
No one has been here.
I settle back down onto the mud.

lines.zh: 水热了起来，我往深处沉。
lines.en: The water heats and I sink deep.
I hit the mud and roll over.
Not enough air and I thrash.
The blast lifts the water and rolls me.
Something passes through my fin.

lines.zh: 一阵凉意在水中缠上来。
lines.en: Chill coils around me in the water.

lines.zh: 水里没嘴边的食，我力气耗完了。
lines.en: No food in the water and my strength is gone.
Lightning runs the water through all of me.

lines.zh: 水没了，底也没了，我只往下。
lines.en: No water, no bottom; I just fall.
